title: The longest mountain chain lies mostly beneath the sea
body: The mid-ocean ridge system extends for nearly 65,000 km across Earth's oceans. More than 90% lies underwater, where it traces the boundaries at which tectonic plates pull apart.
takeaway: Maps of dry land miss a mountain system that links several ocean basins.
source: NOAA Ocean Exploration, What Is a Mid-Ocean Ridge?
visual: a long chain of jagged peaks rising from a dark ocean floor
